objective: Inspect actual synthetic slot-cookie destinations, reassign originally blue-pinned clients and require fresh complete evidence before blue retirement; nominal percentages are not migration proof.
preconditions: Two healthy compatible synthetic slots named blue and green.
No native Azure target, real cookie, cloud access, account, package installation or server is required.
Use standard browser HTML/JavaScript with keyboard-accessible controls.
actions: Apply nominal green allocation from 0 to 100; this starts a new evidence epoch without changing pins.
Replay all four fixed clients to inspect actual destinations.
After current-epoch inspection, reassign or retry either originally blue-pinned client at green with a complete, interrupted or unknown reply.
Attempt guarded blue retirement; blocked attempts retain blue without inventing user interruptions.
Archive the full run and reset known defaults; retain at most three complete prior runs with counted eviction.

syntheticInputTrace.routingRule: A slot pin overrides nominal allocation. Only unpinned new-d uses bucket < greenPercent.

expectedAssertions: At nominal 100%, initial replay still observes two blue and two green destinations, with zero of two originally blue-pinned clients migrated.
A cookie assignment alone never proves migration; a complete current-epoch green reply is required.
Retirement requires nominal 100% and fresh complete green observations for all four clients.
An interruption permanently makes cumulative run impact failure; otherwise any missing reply permanently makes it unknown even after current readiness recovers.
Pre-existing green clients and new clients never inflate originally blue-pinned migration counts.
Strict schemas, state replay validation, action bounds and immutable snapshots preserve the run on invalid input.

limits.persistence: In-memory page lifetime only; reload clears current and archived history.
limits.nativeQualification: No real slot, cookie expiry, browser-cookie policy, authentication/session migration, worker affinity, drain, in-flight work, production runtime or native retirement is exercised.
